newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa approves takeover of old Namibian debt.
newsitem.headline: South Africa approves takeover of old Namibian debt.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela's cabinet on Wednesday officially approved an agreement for his government to take over Namibia's pre-independence South African government-guaranteed debt.
The cabinet said in a statement after their last meeting of the year that the debt-takeover had been agreed by Mandela and Namibian President Sam Nujoma.
South Africa said in 1994 it would write off Namibian debts of 1.4 billion rand -- then worth $400 million -- dating from the years when Pretoria controlled the neighbouring country.
Any debts incurred after South-West Africa, a U.N. protectorate run by South Africa, won independence in 1990 and became Namibia was not covered.
